items.html: And so, here they are divided into five parts, as is known: twenty-four consecutive combinations begin with the letter Alef of Elokim, and twenty-four begin with the letter Lamed; twenty-four begin with the letter Hey, twenty-four with the letter Yud, and twenty-four with the letter final Mem. Thus they are five times twenty-four, and we find that they are five names of Elokim in her five lower Sefirot, in the aspect of the posterior. And each name of Elokim includes all twenty-four combinations, so that the five names of Elokim together include all one hundred and twenty.
